name: place-helper
description: Sample plugin: read a project data file, render a template, and call the roforge CLI. No code — declarative actions only.

tools.name: read_project_note
tools.description: Read the project's NOTE.md (fixed relative path, size-capped — no path injection).

tools.name: changelog_line
tools.description: Render a changelog line from args (template fill — no code).

tools.name: roforge_version
tools.description: Print the installed roforge CLI version (allowlisted binary, argv array, no shell).
